name: Vestige Cognitive Memory
description: Shared cognitive memory for OpenClaw agents powered by Vestige — FSRS-6 spaced repetition, dual-strength memory, and prediction error gating.
author: BigHat Biosciences

authToken.description: Bearer token for Vestige API authentication

hooksEnabled.description: Enable hook-based automatic memory retrieval and ingestion

scorerApiKey.description: API key for the saliency scorer LLM (e.g., Anthropic key for Haiku)

scorerModel.description: Model for saliency scoring (cheap/fast model recommended)

scorerTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for scorer LLM calls in ms

retrieveThreshold.description: Minimum saliency score to trigger memory retrieval (0-1)

storeThreshold.description: Minimum importance score to trigger memory storage (0-1)

maxMemories.description: Maximum memories to inject per turn

gateLowValueThreshold.description: Max cosine distance from low-value centroid to skip scoring (0-2, lower = stricter)

gateHighValueThreshold.description: Max cosine distance from high-value centroid to auto-score (0-2, lower = stricter)
